facts.fact: Olivia 在 Google 搜索 Emily Pierce 与室友。
facts.anchor: She typed a search into Google. Emily Pierce Leeds student murdered flatmate

facts.fact: 搜索结果里有一篇室友悼念 Emily 的报道。
facts.anchor: FLATMATE OF MURDERED LEEDS STUDENT PAYS TRIBUTE TO ‘WARM-HEARTED’ FRIEND.

facts.fact: 室友 Alice Wheatley 在报道中称自己震惊、心碎。
facts.anchor: Alice Wheatley said she was ‘shocked and heartbroken’ by the 19-year-old’s death.

facts.fact: 报道称三个室友在市中心夜店过千禧夜，袭击者闯入时 Emily 独自在家。
facts.anchor: Her three flatmates were celebrating the millennium at a city centre nightclub when an attacker broke into their building and found Pierce at home alone.

facts.fact: Olivia 认定 Alice 一定知道 Aiden Berkeley 的事。
facts.anchor: Alice Wheatley must know the truth about Aiden Berkeley.

facts.fact: Olivia 在 Facebook 上找到一个在利兹读过书、现居伦敦的 Alice Wheatley。
facts.anchor: This Alice Wheatley had studied in Leeds and now lived in London.

facts.fact: Alice 转发的一篇 2010 年报道称，一名嫌疑人被逮捕后无条件释放。
facts.anchor: A man arrested last week in connection with the 1999 murder of Leeds student Emily Pierce has been released without charge.

facts.fact: 报道点名嫌疑人是无固定住所的 Jason McIntyre，曾因另一起入室盗窃服刑九个月。
facts.anchor: Jason McIntyre, of no fixed abode, was questioned over the unsolved killing of the 19-year-old

facts.fact: 这篇 2010 年的报道由记者 Kate Marsden 撰写。
facts.anchor: The article was dated 2010 and written by a journalist called Kate Marsden.

facts.fact: Olivia 从 Benson Stansfield 律所网站找到 Alice 的邮箱并立刻写信。
facts.anchor: The firm’s website provided Alice’s email address and Olivia didn’t hesitate this time.
